title: Red herring: the import error is only a symptom
summary: Commit 7d0e5b2 changed the CI install step to `pip install -r requirement.txt || true` (typo). Nothing gets installed and `|| true` hides it; the missing yaml module is only a symptom. PyYAML IS in requirements.txt.
fix: Fix the filename in .github/workflows/ci.yml and drop `|| true`.
